documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Pushpa Jewellers Limited is a B2B-focused gold jewellery manufacturer operating on an asset-light model with outsourced manufacturing through independent karigars. For H1-FY26, the company reported operational revenue of INR 1,710 Mn, EBITDA of INR 159 Mn, and a PAT of INR 110 Mn. Management outlines future growth strategies including geographic expansion, digital transformation with SAP ERP, product premiumisation with lab-grown diamonds, and AI-fuelled lead management. Pushpa Jewellers reported total income of 28,127.08 Lakhs and net profit of 2,228.63 Lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2025. The company successfully completed a bonus issue, increased its authorized share capital, and launched a fresh Initial Public Offering (IPO) raising 7,893.90 lakhs through the issuance of fresh equity shares listed on the NSE SME Emerge Platform.

demand_outlook.claim: India's jewellery market is growing at a 16% CAGR, expanding from USD 80 Bn in 2024 to USD 145 Bn by 2028.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s jewellery market is growing at a 16% CAGR, expanding from USD 80 Bn in 2024 to USD 145 Bn by 2028.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand trends during the fiscal year were supported by a recovery in consumer spending across key global markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand trends during FY 2024–25 were supported by a recovery in consumer spending in key markets, notably the United States, China, the Middle East, and parts of Europe, alongside resilient purchasing in emerging economies.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic consumption remained resilient due to a buoyant wedding season, festive demand, and adoption of hallmarked products.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic consumption remained resilient, driven by a buoyant wedding season, festive demand, and growing adoption of hallmarked and certified jewellery in compliance with mandatory BIS norms.

margins_costs.claim: The industry navigated challenges including high import duties on gold, precious metal price volatility, and rising compliance costs.
margins_costs.quote: The industry, however, continued to navigate challenges including high import duties on gold, volatility in precious metal prices, and rising regulatory compliance costs.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an extensive portfolio of 2,367 jewellery designs, with an average product price at INR 62,045.
orders_capacity.quote: Extensive portfolio of 2,367 jewellery designs, with Average Product Price at INR 62,045

capital_allocation.claim: The board did not recommend any dividend on equity shares for the financial year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board does not recommend any Dividend on Equity Shares for the Financial Year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised 7,893.90 lakhs through a fresh SME IPO issue of 5,37,000 equity shares.
capital_allocation.quote: Between the end of the financial year of the Company to which financial statements relates and the date of the report, the Company raised ₹7893.90 lakhs by issuing 53,70,000 fresh Equity Shares at an issue price of ₹147 per share, which included a premium of ₹ 137 per share through SME IPO.

capital_allocation.claim: Authorized share capital was increased from 60,00,000 to 25,00,00,000 rupees during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year under review, the authorized share capital of the Company was increased from ₹60,00,000 to ₹25,00,00,000.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions, mine production constraints, and trade policies influenced raw material availability and pricing globally.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the supply side, geopolitical tensions, mine production constraints, and changing trade policies influenced raw material availability and pricing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in precious metal prices and import duties influenced procurement strategies and working capital requirements.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the supply side, volatility in gold and diamond prices, combined with elevated import duties, influenced procurement strategies and working capital requirements.

risks_headwinds.claim: The jewellery industry is subject to risks like precious metal price volatility, import duties, and foreign exchange fluctuations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The jewellery industry remains subject to multiple risks, including volatility in gold, silver, and diamond prices, which can impact both consumer sentiment and the Company’s procurement costs.

management_commitments.claim: The company is committed to spending the unspent CSR amount within 6 months from the end of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: The Company is committed to spending this unspent amount within 6 months from the end of this financial year in compliance with Section 135 of the Companies Act, 2013.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
